cells.gaps: The only law held is a 2022 Civil Status Act amendment letting the Bank of Mauritius share population data for Central KYC, a law for one purpose; nothing names a law, decree or draft on public bodies sharing data in general.
cells.note: Hand-staged on the rebuild of 2026-11-10: the Civil Status Act amendment enables one exchange for customer checks in banking, and a law for one sector places nothing, as Kenya's Digital Health Act does not.
